name: Information Wallpaper Overlay
author: Adrian Wild
description: Information on your wallpaper: up to six tiles behind your windows, the way Hyprland tiles windows. GitHub repos with a year of commits as a twinkling heatmap, stars, PRs, issues, releases and live Actions runs; herdr's coding agents, which are working and which are waiting for you; long tasks on the machine, like builds, flashing and updates, passed or failed; and what's playing, with its cover. It follows your theme and Hyprland's gaps and rounding, never takes a click, uses your gh CLI login, and can fill the lock screen too. A tray icon shows the CI status and opens the settings.

barWidget.description: CI status, and the settings for the information tiles on the desktop.
